prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (services, industry, budget, company size, timeline, KPIs). I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me give a tailored shortlist:

1. What services do you need? (e.g., digital advertising/PPC, SEO, content marketing, branding, web design, social, PR, B2B demand gen)
2. What industry are you in? (e.g., healthcare, professional services, fintech, education, e‑commerce)
3. Company size and monthly marketing budget (ballpark)?
4. Do you prefer an agency local to a specific Maryland city (Baltimore, Annapolis, Bethesda) or is remote okay?
5. Desired start timeline and main performance goals (leads, revenue, brand awareness, app installs, etc.)

If you want to start researching on your own, use these resources and evaluation tips:
- Directories: Clutch.co, UpCity, DesignRush, Agency Spotter, Google Business/Maps and LinkedIn.
- Evaluation checklist: client case studies and measurable outcomes, industry experience, sample reporting, team bios, pricing model, contract length, references, cultural fit.
- Interview questions to ask agencies: typical onboarding process, examples of similar work, expected KPIs and timelines, tools/platforms used, who will be your day‑to‑day contact, cancellation terms.

Tell me the answers to the quick questions and I’ll create a short list of Maryland agencies (with why each could fit, pros/cons and suggested next steps).
